expectedTruths: Population (standardised common factors): SAT = 0.60 SQ + zeta; LOY = 0.25 SQ + 0.55 SAT + zeta; indirect SQ->LOY = 0.60 * 0.55 = 0.33; total SQ->LOY = 0.58; R^2(SAT) = 0.36, R^2(LOY) = 0.530000.

CB-SEM degrees of freedom = 62: 13 indicators give 91 covariance moments; 29 free parameters (10 free loadings + 13 residual variances + 1 exogenous factor variance + 2 disturbance variances + 3 paths, marker identification). A mean structure adds 13 means and 13 intercepts and leaves df unchanged.
ML and MLR give identical point estimates; only standard errors and the test statistic differ.

Classic PLS-SEM targets composites, a different estimand: its population limit on the continuous responses is SQ->SAT = 0.527091, SQ->LOY = 0.249326, SAT->LOY = 0.487134 (population.json derivedTruths.classicPlsPopulationLimit). PLS and CB estimates must never be merged or labelled interchangeably.
Sample estimates on the 7-point items are compared engine-to-engine; the population values are approached only approximately because of discretisation and sampling error.
